purpose: Draft finite-slice ledger for the typed-provenance coincidence model (#283 / PR #284). This is not an all-events theorem and does not close CO3 or CO4.

entries.claim: The bare split definition is vacuous on every closed word of length at least two (CO0). On a typed provenance schedule (Origin x Twist), first joint closure (CO1/CO2) is well-defined; a strong co-incidence has both sides open and not in the product sector, while a product-sector contrast is not strong.
entries.formal_scope: Finite ZFA-closed words through length 6 for CO0, plus fixed typed-provenance examples for CO1/CO2. This is not a census of all interaction events, not an all-events resolution theorem, and not a causation claim.
entries.comparator: Exhaustive CO0 census and declared CO1/CO2 examples in coincidence.py and data/coincidence_census.json.
entries.kill_condition: A closed word of length >= 2 without a vacuous split, a first-joint-closure example whose provenance is assigned after the split, or any all-events conclusion not backed by CO3/CO4.
